verdict.rationale: Exa documents its own background automation through Websets. These are 'Scheduled searches that surface new events on the web', plus async deep research, list building and enrichment. Results arrive asynchronously via the dashboard, API or webhooks, with real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched. However, the scheduling capability appears only as a one-line pricing description, with no documentation of how to configure schedules, triggers or recurring jobs. Missing for 10: documented schedule/monitor configuration (cadence, triggers, management), broader automation beyond Websets searches, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs working autonomously.
